identification: Two boxes: a plastic tub of about 30 mixed cookbooks (Charmaine Solomon Thai and Complete Vegetarian, Margaret Fulton, Greta Anna, Women's Weekly Stews & Casseroles, Jamie Oliver Easy Air Fryer, Bill Granger, Guy Grossi, Christine Manfield Fire & Spice, delicious., Reader's Digest) plus a box of kitchenalia: red retro-style kitchen scale with steel bowl, glass stovetop percolator (Pyrex Flameware-style, brown handle), glass teapot with infuser, stainless teapot, cafetiere; and a wooden canteen holding a partial set of mid-century plated/stainless cutlery with flat modern handles and amber detail (maker not legible). Common modern goods, low value.

viewing_check: 1) Gretta Anna books: open to the title page and imprint page; a Quando first or a signed/inscribed copy is worth more, an A&R reprint is not. 2) More Gretta Anna: check for an author signature on the endpaper. 3) Cutlery canteen: read the maker marks, count the pieces, check the plating. 4) Kitchenalia: look for enamel, Bakelite, cast iron. 5) Read the three unreadable spines.
